text:
jorge_acme: Hi team — noticed a sharp drop in translation quality for FR/DE after the rollout last night. Examples attached. Not an API error, responses are just wrong/English fallback in many cases.

maria_cs: Sorry to hear that — can you paste minimal repro request + one good/bad output pair? Also your region and model id?

jorge_acme: Sure. We're calling the hosted API in eu-west with API key scoped to AcmeLocalization. Model param: "redwood-instruct-2.1" and we saw this immediately after the canary rolled at ~2026-03-10T22:05Z. Minimal curl: 

```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-2.1","input":"Translate to French: \"The shipment arrived late and the labels were swapped.\"","temperature":0.0}'
```

Before rollout (Good):
"L'envoi est arrivé en retard et les étiquettes ont été inversées."

After rollout (Bad):
"The shipment arrived late and the labels were swapped."

Also for German: 
Input: "Please translate to German: \"Can you confirm the SKU numbers?\""
Before: "Können Sie die SKU-Nummern bestätigen?"
After: "Can you confirm the SKU numbers?"

akash_support: Thanks — so outputs are switching to English rather than translating. Any differences in prompt format between calls? Are you using prefix context or a system message?

jorge_acme: No system message. We pass only that single input string. Temperature 0, sometimes 0.2 in prod. No errors in logs, latency normal. We capture token usage — same token counts.

maria_cs: I've created a ticket CS-8743 and linked your examples. @leah_prod assigning to product and ML. Could you also include the request IDs for two calls (one before, one after) if you have them?

jorge_acme: Request IDs: req-20260310-7823 (before), req-20260310-9981 (after). I've attached full JSON for both in the ticket.

leah_prod: Copying @kai_ml and @eva_l10n. Kai — can you triage model-side? Looks like a regression in non-English behavior after the canary.

kai_ml: Looking. Early theory: a recent change to prefix-KV caching + tokenizer normalization could make short prompts be treated as English-only in the decode heuristics. I'm going to 1) reproduce locally with same model binary 2) run the curated FR/DE eval set.

eva_l10n: Also want to check if this affects other Romance/Germanic languages (es, it, nl). Jorge — do you have Spanish examples?

jorge_acme: Spanish seems okay so far — it's mainly FR/DE.

sre_bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout canary-2026-03-10 completed at 2026-03-10T22:04:50Z to eu-west-1.

leah_prod: Kai — if the regression is tied to that canary, need to know risk of rollback. Are you able to produce deterministic repro?

kai_ml: Repro steps I'm running now. Quick note: try forcing "language" in prompt (e.g., "Translate to French:") vs using a system message "You are a translator to French." — helps to confirm whether decoder conditioning is being ignored.

maria_cs: While Kai looks into the model, can we ask the customer for timing/gamma? Jorge — can you run the same curl but set "response_format": "json-with-metadata" (our debug flag) and paste the full returned metadata? We want logits/top_tokens if available.

jorge_acme: Sending now. Returned metadata shows top tokens are English words like "The" and "shipment" with high logprob. I'll paste a snippet: 

```json
{"request_id":"req-20260310-9981","top_tokens":[{"token":"The","prob":0.42},{"token":"shipment","prob":0.21}],"model":"redwood-instruct-2.1","quant_profile":"q4_2a"}
```

leah_prod: Interesting — quant_profile q4_2a was part of the canary. Kai — could quantization change tokenization boundaries for non-Latin scripts or language detection heuristics?

kai_ml: It can. q4_2a changes embedding/kv quantization packing which in rare cases interacts with the early beam heuristics we use for language detection in the first tokens. Reproduced locally: at temperature 0, short prompts, the model outputs English. At temp 0.2 the model sometimes outputs target language but sometimes misc. Running an A/B with old quant profile now.

akash_support: If this is the cause, customers with short explicit "Translate to X:" prompts are impacted — high severity. Need mitigation plan ASAP.

maria_cs: SLA impact: customers report degraded UX but no downtime. Still priority P1 for multilingual customers. Jorge, we'll keep updates in ticket and schedule a call if needed.

kai_ml: Quick mitigation options: 1) Rollback quant profile to q3_safe for canary nodes (fast) 2) Add prompt-aware pre-token normalization path (slower) 3) Server-side post-filter: if first token is English and prompt asked for translation, force re-gen with different decoding settings.

leah_prod: Can we test 1) quickly in eu-west on a small subset of traffic? SRE — can you patch canary nodes to q3_safe?

sre_bot: deploy-bot: Starting patch job to replace quant_profile q4_2a -> q3_safe on canary nodes in eu-west. Estimated 10m.

maria_cs: Jorge — small ask: after we patch, can you re-run your failing example and confirm? We'll update CS-8743 and follow-up with formal RCA.

jorge_acme: Will do — thank you.

leah_prod: Kai, after patch, run full FR/DE eval and produce diff metrics (BLEU/chrF and a small human check) and share in the ticket. If patch fixes it, we'll schedule a controlled rollout of q3_safe for all clusters and bake more checks into the canary for language parity.

kai_ml: On it. Also adding an automated prompt-check: if prompt contains explicit "Translate to <lang>:" we run a quick language-identity check in the first 5 tokens and fail the canary if mismatch rate > 1%.

akash_support: Noting follow-ups: update docs about quant profiles, notify Account Exec for AcmeLocalization, offer credits/comp if needed.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open. If anything changes, drop it here and I'll ping Jorge with status updates. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Patch job completed at 2026-03-10T22:12:40Z — rollback profile applied to canary nodes.

jorge_acme: Re-tested at 22:14Z — FR/DE outputs restored to expected translations. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

leah_prod: Great. Closing immediate customer impact. Kai — please create a short postmortem draft in the ticket with root cause, fix, and long-term safeguards.

kai_ml: Will do — draft by EOD. Summary: regression introduced by q4_2a quantization packing interacting with decoder language heuristics; mitigated by reverting to q3_safe and adding prompt-aware checks.

maria_cs: Jorge — we'll leave the ticket open for follow-up and reach out about compensation. Appreciate your patience.

jorge_acme: Appreciate the quick patch, team.

leah_prod: Thanks all.
